why: Los Angeles tee company from 2019, the $35 cotton-poly crew cut for men's bodies and sold in packs, now with chinos and jackets; 13 stores of its own, plus Target and Costco.

notes.tech: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-11): House fabric names on /pages/fabrics: Classic Jersey, Active Jersey, Flex Comfort, Warm Fleece, Comfort Denim, Casual Knit, Authentic Jeans, Dynamic Twill, Soft Modal, Comfort Waffle; UPF 30 / UPF 15 sun-protection claims on Active tops — owned names for generic blends (no trademark or licensed membrane/fibre named); share of range Active line 25 of 112 styles (22%) carries performance claims (quick-dry, UPF); . Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 1 (2026-10-11): True Classic names no factory, maker or mill and states no country of origin on any of 1,139 men's product records. Its fabric page is house names for cotton/poly blends, and the FAQ's "very unique process" is a claim with nothing behind it. Making is placed only by press (contract plants in four countries), not by the brand. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
